C9000112.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 112 (Beyond the square-root exponent for depth-three circuits.; papers: Beyond the Square-Root Exponent for Depth-Three Boolean Circuits; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/112.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_RESTRICTION_INDEPENDENT.statement: For arbitrary finite CNFs, construct pointwise signed width-b expansions with expected absolute mass at most one under theta<=1, uniformly over all real-valued tests.
C_RESTRICTION_INDEPENDENT.mechanical_status: Lean 4.31.0 exit_code=0, proof_holes=[]; the current source and statement-fidelity document are bound to the certificate.
C_RESTRICTION_INDEPENDENT.remaining_obligation: Host-invoked independent Reviewer replay, statement fidelity, significance and novelty assessment.

L_RESTRICTION_EXPANSION.statement: The finite clause-insertion expansion represents the restricted CNF pointwise and all atoms have width at most b, including every degenerate case.

L_RESTRICTION_EXPECTATION.statement: An exact product-law change of variables pays the hard-case insertion cost from false-clause restrictions, implying expected mass at most one for every finite clause list.

C_RESTRICTION_MANUSCRIPT.statement: The original existential Lemma lem:restriction, including simultaneous control of every real-valued G and its 1/(1-theta) expectation bound, follows from the independently constructed cost.

C_MAIN_CIRCUIT.statement: The staged main theorem constructs one polynomial-time language with log_2 S_3(f_n)/sqrt(n) tending to infinity. This mission does not certify the full theorem.

C_SPARSE_PARTITION.statement: Every width-b CNF on m>=1 variables has a disjoint sum into at most 2^(eta m) width-b CNFs with O_(b,eta)(m) clauses.

C_GOOD_SLICES.statement: For every fixed b>=1 and B>0, all sufficiently large input lengths admit one slice whose bad restriction probability is at most 4*2^(-B sqrt(d)/16), simultaneously over all width-b tests.

C_POLYTIME_EVALUATOR.statement: The specified quotient-ring evaluator decides the language on every input in a single fixed polynomial time bound.
